title: Cave of poisoned Aboriginal tribe littered with bones

tellings.quote: my friend Adam Greenree visited a site where um they had given food to this entire tribe of Australian aborigis that were tainted that was all poisoned and the the entire cave, he said, is just littered with human bones.

plain: Somewhere in Australia there is a cave where a whole tribe of Aboriginal people was given poisoned food, and the cave is "just littered with human bones." The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan tells this on Michels's show, passing on what his friend Adam Greenree told him after visiting the site.
